title: Druqks Engine
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A high-velocity OberheimDMX workout at 180 BPM where Euclidean kick and hi-hat patterns collide with a sawtooth bassline that sweeps up to 3kHz. Supersaw stabs and pentatonic arpeggios thread through the denser sections, and a snare-roll avalanche in the centrepiece builds to peak-time intensity before the final sparse wind-down.
code:
setcpm(180/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0).shape(0.2),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(250, 900)).resonance(10).decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.7)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.05).shape(0.25),
    s("~ sd").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.85).room(0.25),
    s("hh(7,16)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(300, 1600)).resonance(11).decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.78)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.1).shape(0.3),
    s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.85).room(0.3).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh*8").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).pan(sine.fast(2).range(0.25, 0.75)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2).ply("<1 1 2 1>"),
    note("<c2 g1 eb2 bb1>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400, 2200)).resonance(12).decay(0.16).sustain(0).gain(0.8),
    n("0 3 5 7").scale("C4:minor:pentatonic").s("supersaw").lpf(1800).decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.55).room(0.3).delay(0.3)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.95),
    note("<c2 eb2>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 1200)).resonance(10).room(0.5).decay(0.4).sustain(0.3).gain(0.7),
    n("<0 3 7 10>").scale("C4:minor").s("supersaw").lpf(1400).attack(0.05).sustain(0.4).gain(0.5).room(0.6).delay(".4:.25:.5")
  )],
  [40, stack(
    s("bd(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.1).shape(0.35),
    s("sd*16").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.7).room(0.3).ply("<1 2 4 8>").pan(sine.fast(4).range(0.2, 0.8)),
    s("hh(9,16)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15).jux(rev),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.6).room(0.4).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<c2 g1 eb2 bb1>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(40).range(500, 3000)).resonance(13).decay(0.14).sustain(0).gain(0.82),
    n("0 3 5 7 5 3").scale("C4:minor:pentatonic").s("supersaw").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(1200, 3200)).decay(0.18).sustain(0.1).gain(0.55).jux(rev).delay(0.3)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1.0).shape(0.2),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("<c2 c2 eb2 g1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(800, 250)).resonance(10).decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.7).room(0.4)
  )]
)
